mapper.sql: id, warehouse_code, partner_name, shop_id, partner_token, expires_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse_partner ( warehouse_code, partner_name, shop_id, partner_token, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{warehouseCode}, #{partnerName}, #{shopId}, #{partnerToken}, #{expiresAt} ) ON CONFLICT (warehouse_code, partner_name) DO UPDATE SET partner_token = EXCLUDED.partner_token, shop_id = EXCLUDED.shop_id, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
